name: duplicate-install-warning-preserved
body: `apg init`'s duplicate-install warning is preserved in full: when a repo's `.opencode/` holds a file that duplicates a file the suite installs under the global opencode config directory `~/.config/opencode/` — `implementation-phase-reviewer.md` among them — `apg init` prints the loud warning listing the duplicate and deletes nothing. The detection concerns the documented V2 locations: a project `.opencode/` file and the installed copies under `~/.config/opencode/`. The upgrade guide (`APG_UPGRADE_DOC`) documents the manual removal of a duplicated local reviewer. Suppressing the warning for any such file, or auto-deleting it, is a violation. Satisfaction is assessed by review.
